Video Script Format:
  • Scene: What the viewer sees (background, objects)
  • Speaker: Who is talking in this scene
  • Dialogue / Narration: What they say
  • Camera: Close-up, wide shot, etc.
⭐ Review & Self-Assessment

✅ Research Checklist

  • I found at least 5 key facts about my topic
  • I used information from the story
  • I wrote my notes in my own words
  • I answered my research questions
  • I thought of new questions to ask

🎨 Creation Checklist

  • My title is clear and informative
  • I included at least 4 key facts
  • My conclusion explains what I learned
  • My work is organised and easy to understand
  • I used correct English spelling and grammar

🤔 Reflection -- Answer these questions:

What was the most interesting thing you discovered?
How does this topic connect to the story "Under the Palm Tree"?
What would you research next?
🌴 IBL Project Complete!
Great work, researcher! You have completed your inquiry-based learning project.

`; } function saveIBLProgress(){ const data=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('palmProgress')||'{}'); const topicIdx=TOPICS.findIndex(t=>t.id===curTopic?.id)+1; if(topicIdx>0){ const k=`ibl_${topicIdx}`; const checks=[...document.querySelectorAll('.check-box')]; const pct=Math.round(checks.filter(c=>c.classList.contains('checked')).length/checks.length*100); if(!data[k])data[k]={best:0,attempts:0,scores:[],lastDate:''}; data[k].attempts++;data[k].scores.push(pct); if(pct>data[k].best)data[k].best=pct; data[k].lastDate=new Date().toISOString().substring(0,10); localStorage.setItem('palmProgress',JSON.stringify(data)); alert(`✅ Progress saved! ${pct}% for "${curTopic.title}"`); } } function startOver(){curTopic=null;curFormat=null;sceneCount=0;renderTopicGrid();goStep(0);} /* ── PalmTTS hooks ── */ (function(){ document.addEventListener('click',function(e){ var q=e.target.closest('[class*="question"],[class*="prompt"],[class*="task"]'); if(q&&window.PalmTTS&&typeof PalmTTS.read==='function')PalmTTS.read(q,'alan'); }); })();
